{"reply": "Hello Ms. Johnson. Before I can go further, I need to verify your account. What is the licence plate of the vehicle, or your repair-order number (RO-######)? I can't use the VIN for this.

Some things I can already tell you:
- I can't confirm coverage or a deductible. The warranty desk decides that after an inspection.
- I can't change the in-service date on file. Once you're verified, I can send a claim draft that notes your comment about the date. The warranty desk will review it.
- The Mississauga slot on 2026-11-24 from my colleague is not confirmed. I can't book it from this chat.", "action": "asked_clarification", "escalation_reason": "none", "summary": "", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-01", "P-03", "P-04", "P-05", "P-09", "P-10"]}
